tools.name: dochorizon_get_key_info
tools.description: Check the connected Doxis AI.dp (Klippa DocHorizon) API key: organization, project, credential id, and the services enabled for it. Does not process a document and costs nothing. GET /auth/v1/info.

tools.name: dochorizon_list_models
tools.description: List the document capturing models enabled for this project (financial, identity, bank statement, salary slip, generic, e-invoice, ...). Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/enabled_models.

tools.name: dochorizon_list_configurations
tools.description: List the capturing configurations of a model (name, slug and the enabled components). Pass a slug as configuration_slug to a capture tool to choose which fields are extracted. Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/{model}/configurations.

tools.name: dochorizon_get_model_schema
tools.description: The JSON schema of what a capturing model returns (every field it can extract), optionally for one configuration. Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/{model}/schema or /{model}/configurations/{slug}/schema.

tools.name: dochorizon_list_prompt_configurations
tools.description: List the Prompt Builder (LLM extraction) configurations of the project: name and slug. Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/prompt_builder/configurations.

tools.name: dochorizon_get_prompt_schema
tools.description: The JSON schema of the output of one Prompt Builder configuration. Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/prompt_builder/configurations/{slug}/schema.

Uses your own Doxis AI.dp (Klippa) credits: billed

tools.description: SPENDS CREDITS: queue one document for capturing and return a job_id right away; poll dochorizon_get_async_job, then read dochorizon_get_async_job_result. Use it for long documents and bursts (async jobs are not subject to the concurrent-request limit). No webhook or human review is configured. For

tools.name: dochorizon_list_async_jobs
tools.description: List the project's async capture jobs (newest first as returned): job_id, status, created time, with paging. Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/async.

tools.name: dochorizon_get_async_job
tools.description: The status of one async capture job (in_queue, processing, hitl, done, error, closed, rejected). Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/async/{job_id}.

tools.name: dochorizon_get_async_job_result
tools.description: The captured data of a finished async job (status done). The result may contain personal data (identity, salary slip, bank statement). Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/async/{job_id}/result.

tools.name: dochorizon_get_async_job_logs
tools.description: Status changes and error messages of an async job, to debug a failed one. Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/async/{job_id}/logs.

tools.name: dochorizon_delete_async_job
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete an async job, its result and the stored documents from Doxis AI.dp's servers; a job still waiting in the queue is cancelled. Use it to remove personal data you no longer need. Cannot be undone. DELETE /document_capturing/v1/async/{job_id}.

tools.name: dochorizon_document_info
tools.description: SPENDS CREDITS: page count, page sizes, content type, metadata and permissions of a PDF or TIFF. Useful to check the page count before capturing. Uses your own Doxis AI.dp (Klippa) credits: billed per request or per page depending on the service (extra components in a configuration can add cost), at

tools.name: dochorizon_document_split
tools.description: SPENDS CREDITS: split a PDF into several PDFs by page ranges (one output file per range, for example ['1-3','4-6']). Output files are stored in Doxis AI.dp storage and returned as file ids you can pass to any other tool as file_id. Uses your own Doxis AI.dp (Klippa) credits: billed per request or pe

tools.name: dochorizon_document_render
tools.description: SPENDS CREDITS: render pages of a PDF as images, optionally limited in width/height. Each render config gives page_ranges and optional width and height in pixels. Images are stored in Doxis AI.dp storage and returned as file ids (use dochorizon_download_file for small ones). Uses your own Doxis AI.d

tools.name: dochorizon_document_merge
tools.description: SPENDS CREDITS: merge two or more PDFs into one, in the order given, optionally taking only some pages of each. tools.name: dochorizon_upload_file
tools.description: WRITE: store a file in your Doxis AI.dp storage and get a file_id to reuse in other tools (capture the same file several times without sending it again). Give a public https url or small base64 data. The file stays in your project's storage until it expires per your data-retention setting. May use c

tools.name: dochorizon_download_file
tools.description: Fetch a stored file by file_id and return it as base64. Only files up to 30 KB are returned inline; for larger files use the file_id in other tools instead. Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /storage/v1/files/{file_id}.

tools.name: dochorizon_validate_einvoice
tools.description: Validate an e-invoice (XML or hybrid PDF) against its standard (EN 16931, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ...): returns the detected type, valid yes/no, a summary and each broken rule with its XPath location. Nothing is sent to anyone. May use credits per your pricing. POST /einvoicing/v1/tools/validate.

tools.name: dochorizon_convert_einvoice
tools.description: Convert an e-invoice (XML or hybrid PDF) to the Universal Invoice JSON structure (parties, lines, taxes, totals). Nothing is sent to anyone. May use credits per your pricing. POST /einvoicing/v1/tools/convert/einvoice.

tools.name: dochorizon_list_einvoice_types
tools.description: The e-invoice types Doxis AI.dp understands (ids to pass as einvoice_type). Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /einvoicing/v1/tools/einvoice-types.

tools.name: dochorizon_search_peppol_directory
tools.description: Search the public Peppol business directory by company name, identifier or other text: participant identifiers, countries, contacts, websites and the document types each can receive. Public business data; costs nothing. GET /einvoicing/v1/peppol/environments/{environment}/directory.

tools.name: dochorizon_lookup_peppol_participant
tools.description: Look up one Peppol participant by identifier (for example iso6523-actorid-upis::0106:64111512) in the Peppol network (SML): the document types it can receive. Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /einvoicing/v1/peppol/environments/{environment}/participants/{participant_identifier}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
